BL-638 — Gherkin acceptance mutation reports `Total 0` as a pass for any feature without a Scenario Outline — and stamps the file so later runs skip it
What it solves: Priced `severity: high` despite nothing being broken at runtime: this is a **quality
gate reporting success while testing nothing**, on 60% of the corpus, and it
suppresses its own future runs. A gate that cannot fail is worse than an absent one,
because the absent one does not stop anyone looking.
Approval context: Operator ruling 2026-07-25, handed forward by BL-567's hardener and QA stages. Found while running the gate against a real feature; the hardener could not satisfy it and built a substitute rather than declare it passed. 60% of the feature corpus is exposed.
